_comment: Animals (Roadmap 2 S5): stray dogs and cats on the sidewalks, cows and goats in Old Dhaka and the countryside fields, crows on wires and rooftops, ducks on lakes and ponds. Code-built low-poly models drawn with a few InstancedMeshes (src/features/animals/). quality = how many of each kind live around Shoumik at once (total = the most of all kinds together). spawn = metres around Shoumik where animals appear / disappear (minDistanceInView: not right in front of the camera). kinds: size = body length (metres), speed = walking speed range, run = running speed, colours = body colours, one per animal (crows: their black and grey are in the model, the colour only tints it), where = street (sidewalks), herd (Old Dhaka lanes + countryside fields), perch (wires, rooftops), water (lakes, ponds); districts / zones = where herd animals live; idle = share of the time spent sitting / grazing; fly = birds: flying speed, climb speed and how far away they are removed. behaviour: scareRadius = a gunshot / explosion / danger this close makes them run (birds fly off); carRadius + carSpeed = a vehicle this close and fast makes them jump away (a car only scares them: no injuries for animals); fleeSeconds = how long they run; playerRadius = they step away from Shoumik walking into them.
